# GraphLan Visualization
## bac
```{r}
# Parameter settings
# Filter by abundance
abundance = 0.1
# Filter by number
number = 300

# Read input files
otutab = read.table("otutab_bac.txt", sep="\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")
taxonomy = read.table("taxonomy_bac.txt", sep="\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")


# Data filtering
# Normalize and calculate the mean
norm = as.data.frame(t(t(otutab)/colSums(otutab,na=T)*100))
# Sort abundance in descending order
idx = order(rowMeans(norm), decreasing = T)
norm = norm[idx,]

# Filter by abundance
idx = rowMeans(norm) > abundance
filtered_otutab = norm[idx,]

# Filter by number
filtered_otutab = head(filtered_otutab, number)
# Add mean values and retain 4 decimal places
filtered_otutab = round(cbind(rowMeans(filtered_otutab), filtered_otutab), digits = 4)
colnames(filtered_otutab)[1] = "Mean"
# Filter the corresponding taxonomic annotations
idx = rownames(filtered_otutab) %in% rownames(taxonomy)
filtered_otutab = filtered_otutab[idx,]
filtered_taxonomy = taxonomy[rownames(filtered_otutab),]

# Save output files
# Filtered OTU table
write.table("OTUID\t", file="filtered_otutab_bac.txt", append = F, sep="\t", quote=F, eol = "", row.names=F, col.names=F)
suppressWarnings(write.table(filtered_otutab, file="filtered_otutab_bac.txt", append = T, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=T, col.names=T))
# Filtered taxonomic annotations
write.table("OTUID\t", file="filtered_taxonomy_bac.txt", append = F, sep="\t", quote=F, eol = "", row.names=F, col.names=F)
suppressWarnings(write.table(filtered_taxonomy, file="filtered_taxonomy_bac.txt", append = T, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=T, col.names=T))

### Construct the tree backbone
# Read the filtered file without specifying row names
tax = read.table("filtered_taxonomy_bac.txt", sep="\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = F)
# Select five taxonomic ranks from phylum to genus plus OTUID
tree = data.frame(tax[,c(3:7,1)], stringsAsFactors = F)
# head(tree)
## clarify taxonomy, resolve duplicate names across taxonomic ranks, make the ranks identifiable, and maintain consistency with the Greengene format
tree[,1] = paste("p__",tree[,1],sep = "")
tree[,2] = paste("c__",tree[,2],sep = "")
tree[,3] = paste("o__",tree[,3],sep = "")
tree[,4] = paste("f__",tree[,4],sep = "")
# tree[,5] = paste("g__",tree[,5],sep = "")
# save tree backbone, in dot-separated format

# Resolve duplicate family labels
idx = tree[,5] %in% "Unassigned"
# Method 1. Add numerical identifiers to duplicate labels, but this results in too many Unassigned entries
# tree[idx,4] = paste0(tree[idx,4], 1:length(tree[idx,4]))
# Method 2. Remove entries without family-level annotations, reducing the number of entries but improving the visual appearance
tree = tree[!idx,]
# Simplify irregular family names containing underscores
# tree[,5] = gsub('_\\w*',"",tree[,5])
write.table (tree, file="tree1_backbone_bac.txt", sep=".", col.names=F, row.names=F, quote=F)

# List the existing phyla, classes, orders, families, and genera to assign phylum-specific background colors
Phylum_bac = unique(tree[,1]) 
Class_bac = unique(tree[,2])
Order_bac = unique(tree[,3])
Family_bac = unique(tree[,4])
Genus_bac = unique(tree[,5])

# Select families from the four major bacterial phyla and color them by phylum
# To change the taxonomic rank to order, replace column 4 of tree with column 3 and Family with Order
lac = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Lactobacillales",5] 
ent = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Enterobacteriales",5]
bat = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Bacteroidales",5]
bac = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Bacillales",5]
act = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Actinomycetales",5]
nei = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Neisseriales",5]
pse = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Pseudomonadales",5]

# Assign labels, rotate text, and annotate background colors by phylum for each family
# Other taxonomic ranks can also be used, such as Order, Class, or Genus
label_color = data.frame(stringsAsFactors = F)
for (element in Genus_bac)
{
  # element
  anno = data.frame(stringsAsFactors = F)
  anno[1,1] = element
  anno[1,2] = "annotation"
  anno[1,3] = "*"
  # Set text rotation to 90 degrees
  anno[2,1] = element
  anno[2,2] = "annotation_rotation"
  anno[2,3] = "90"
  # Set background colors, assigning a distinct color to each of the four major phyla and grey to the others
  anno[3,1] = element
  anno[3,2] = "annotation_background_color" 
  
  
  # background-image: linear-gradient(to right top, #d16ba5, #c777b9, #ba83ca, #aa8fd8, #9a9ae1, #80a8ef, #60b5f6, #39c1f8, #00d2f3, #00e0df, #35ebc0, #85f29b);
                                    
  if (element %in% lac)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#85F29B"
  } else if (element %in% ent)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#F58D8D"   
  } else if (element %in% bat)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#F7C875"  
  } else if (element %in% bac)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#91DBF6"   
  } else if (element %in% act)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#898FB2"   
  } else if (element %in% nei)
  {
  anno[3,3] = "#9FAFA1"
  } else if (element %in% pse)
  {
  anno[3,3] = "#AAAE8A"
  } else {
      anno[3,3] = "grey"   
  }
  label_color = rbind(label_color,anno)
}
write.table(label_color, "tree2_label_color_bac.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F,col.names = F,row.names = F, na="")
```


## fun

```{r}
abundance = 0.1
number = 300

otutab = read.table("otutab_fun.txt", sep="\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")
taxonomy = read.table("taxonomy_fun.txt", sep="\t", header = TRUE, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = F, comment.char = "")

norm = as.data.frame(t(t(otutab)/colSums(otutab,na=T)*100))
idx = order(rowMeans(norm), decreasing = T)
norm = norm[idx,]

idx = rowMeans(norm) > abundance
filtered_otutab = norm[idx,]

filtered_otutab = round(cbind(rowMeans(filtered_otutab), filtered_otutab), digits = 4)
colnames(filtered_otutab)[1] = "Mean"
idx = rownames(filtered_otutab) %in% rownames(taxonomy)
filtered_otutab = filtered_otutab[idx,]
filtered_taxonomy = taxonomy[rownames(filtered_otutab),]

write.table("OTUID\t", file="filtered_otutab_fun.txt", append = F, sep="\t", quote=F, eol = "", row.names=F, col.names=F)
suppressWarnings(write.table(filtered_otutab, file="filtered_otutab_fun.txt", append = T, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=T, col.names=T))
write.table("OTUID\t", file="filtered_taxonomy_fun.txt", append = F, sep="\t", quote=F, eol = "", row.names=F, col.names=F)
suppressWarnings(write.table(filtered_taxonomy, file="filtered_taxonomy_fun.txt", append = T, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=T, col.names=T))


tax = read.table("filtered_taxonomy_fun.txt", sep="\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = F)
tree = data.frame(tax[,c(3:7,1)], stringsAsFactors = F)
tree[,1] = paste("p__",tree[,1],sep = "")
tree[,2] = paste("c__",tree[,2],sep = "")
tree[,3] = paste("o__",tree[,3],sep = "")
tree[,4] = paste("f__",tree[,4],sep = "")

idx = tree[,5] %in% "Unassigned"
tree[,5] = gsub('_\\w*',"",tree[,5])
write.table (tree, file="tree1_backbone_fun.txt", sep=".", col.names=F, row.names=F, quote=F)

Phylum_fun = unique(tree[,1]) 
Class_fun = unique(tree[,2])
Order_fun = unique(tree[,3])
Family_fun = unique(tree[,4])
Genus_fun = unique(tree[,5])

eur = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Eurotiales",5]
sac = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Saccharomycetales",5] 
ple = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Pleosporales",5]
hyp = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Hypocreales",5]
tri = tree[tree[,3]=="o__Trichosporonales",5]

label_color = data.frame(stringsAsFactors = F)
for (element in Genus_fun)
{
  anno = data.frame(stringsAsFactors = F)
  anno[1,1] = element
  anno[1,2] = "annotation"
  anno[1,3] = "*"
  anno[2,1] = element
  anno[2,2] = "annotation_rotation"
  anno[2,3] = "90"
  anno[3,1] = element
  anno[3,2] = "annotation_background_color" 
  
  
  if (element %in% eur)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#85F29B"
  } else if (element %in% sac)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#F58D8D"   
  } else if (element %in% ple)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#F7C875"  
  } else if (element %in% hyp)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#91DBF6"   
  } else if (element %in% tri)
  {
      anno[3,3] = "#898FB2"

  } else {
      anno[3,3] = "grey"   
  }
  label_color = rbind(label_color,anno)
}
write.table(label_color, "tree2_label_color_fun.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F,col.names = F,row.names = F, na="")
```
